# capcutctl command reference

<!-- GENERATED by `capcutctl contract --markdown` from CLI 0.1.1, contract v2. Do not edit by hand. -->

Transactional commands (marked **T**) snapshot, validate both documents and all mirrors, roll back on failure,
refuse while CapCut is open, and take `--dry-run` (resolve, validate, report, write nothing).

## Start and inspect

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `close` | Quit CapCut and wait: writes are refused while it runs. | `capcutctl close` |
| `contract` | The machine-readable command surface; --markdown renders the skill reference. | `capcutctl contract --markdown` |
| `inspect` | Tracks, canvas and active timeline as JSON. | `capcutctl inspect --project NAME` |
| `new` **T** | Create a project (clone of Preset 3, --blank, or --from a draft). | `capcutctl new --project NAME --blank --dry-run` |
| `preflight` | Will this machine work: deps, artwork, SFX palette, drafts folder. | `capcutctl preflight` |
| `profile` init\|show\|where | The effective style profile, its layers (bundled → yours → --profile), and init for your own. | `capcutctl profile where` |
| `projects` | List CapCut drafts. | `capcutctl projects --json` |
| `scenes` | Every clip: time, track, desc, media, source; --transcript adds what is said. | `capcutctl scenes --project NAME --transcript` |
| `status` | Is CapCut running; optionally wait for it to close. | `capcutctl status --json` |
| `timeline` | ASCII stacked timeline. | `capcutctl timeline --project NAME` |
| `version` | Installed CLI version. | `capcutctl version` |
| `help` | The full help text. | `capcutctl help` |

## Talking head (A-roll)

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `cut` | Analyse a face take (transcript, energy, beats), then build the reviewed keep/order. | `capcutctl cut VIDEO --keep 0,2-9 --order 0,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9 --dry-run` |
| `ripple` **T** | Delete a timeline range on every track and pull everything after it up, keeping each clip's speed. | `capcutctl ripple --project NAME --from 9.64 --to 10.18 --dry-run` |

## Screen recordings (B-roll)

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `add` **T** | Place full-frame source media on an overlay track. | `capcutctl add --project NAME --media screen.mp4 --at 5 --dur 3 --track broll --dry-run` |
| `fade` **T** | Native audio fade in/out on a clip. | `capcutctl fade --project NAME --at 5 --track broll --in 0.08 --out 0.12 --dry-run` |
| `find` | When is it on screen (--shows), said (--says) or did anything happen (--moments). | `capcutctl find "publish" --media screen.mp4 --shows --strip` |
| `localize` **T** | Copy outside media into the draft (fixes "Link media"). | `capcutctl localize --project NAME` |
| `match` **T** | Sentence → screen-moment shot list; weak matches stay on the face; --apply writes. | `capcutctl match --project NAME --screen screen.mp4 --out shots.json` |
| `remove` **T** | Remove a clip. | `capcutctl remove --project NAME --at 5 --track broll --dry-run` |
| `replace-media` **T** | Relink a clip to another file, keeping its keyframes. | `capcutctl replace-media --project NAME --file new.mp4 --at 5 --track broll --dry-run` |
| `shift` **T** | Move a clip in time. | `capcutctl shift --project NAME --at 5 --track broll --by 0.2 --dry-run` |
| `split` **T** | Cut one clip in two at a timeline second; the left half keeps the id, the output names both. | `capcutctl split --project NAME --segments ID --at 5.2 --dry-run` |
| `trim` **T** | Change a clip's source window (source seconds); the talking head stays 1x unless --retime. | `capcutctl trim --project NAME --at 5 --track broll --src 90-94 --dry-run` |
| `verify-shots` | Blind before/action/after check of placed shots; CONTRADICTED blocks. | `capcutctl verify-shots --project NAME --shots shots.json` |
| `volume` **T** | Set a clip's volume. | `capcutctl volume --project NAME --at 5 --track broll --level 0 --dry-run` |

## Layouts and picture

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `blur-broll` **T** | Opt-in motion blur for B-roll already ramped past 8x. | `capcutctl blur-broll --project NAME --segment ID --plan` |
| `grade` **T** | Measure colour; explicit corrections; shared adjust layer; face detail. | `capcutctl grade --project NAME --measure` |
| `layout` audit\|auto\|background\|broll\|circle\|full-face\|list\|screen\|split-screen **T** | Locked layouts: auto, split-screen, circle, full-face, background, broll, screen; audit. | `capcutctl layout auto --project NAME --plan` |
| `reframe` **T** | Keep a moving face framed with native camera keys (Vision). | `capcutctl reframe --project NAME --auto --plan` |

## One-pass build

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `build` **T** | After A-roll sign-off: one edit plan → shots, layout, camera, graphics, sound, gate. | `capcutctl build --project NAME --edit edit.json --dry-run` |
| `variant` **T** | A duplicate of a signed-off edit with another hook: body shifted, opening re-timed, levels kept, gated. | `capcutctl variant --project NAME --hooks hooks.json --hook b --dry-run` |

## Camera and pace

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `cursor` **T** | Editable halo or polished spring pointer and click ripples from recorded telemetry. | `capcutctl cursor --project NAME --auto --style polished --plan` |
| `keyframe` **T** | Eased camera move: --to scale or --focus a source rectangle. | `capcutctl keyframe --project NAME --segments ID --at 12 --to 1.3 --hold 1.2 --plan` |
| `pace` **T** | Speed as arithmetic: compress waiting B-roll, never the face. | `capcutctl pace --project NAME` |
| `punch` **T** | Eased push onto a named on-screen element (OCR locates it), timed by --at or by the --word he says. | `capcutctl punch --project NAME --on Publish --word "hit publish" --dry-run` |
| `ramp` **T** | Split a B-roll clip at its result: ramp the wait, land the result at 1x. | `capcutctl ramp --project NAME --segment ID --speed 20 --dry-run` |
| `screen-motion` **T** | Sparse native eased zooms and connected pans across screen targets. | `capcutctl screen-motion --project NAME --segment ID --regions regions.json --plan` |
| `zoom` **T** | Face pushes on stressed words (--stress), or at explicit times. | `capcutctl zoom --project NAME --stress --plan` |

## Graphics and text

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `animate` **T** | Native CapCut intro/outro animation on a clip. | `capcutctl animate --project NAME --segments ID --intro fade-in --dry-run` |
| `brands` | Known brands, spoken aliases, and which have artwork. | `capcutctl brands` |
| `captions` **T** | Word-by-word native captions in one style; --replace redoes them, --restyle the look, --reposition the places. | `capcutctl captions --project NAME --dry-run` |
| `endcard` **T** | The CTA card on the talking head near the end. | `capcutctl endcard --project NAME --text Follow --dry-run` |
| `ending` **T** | Append a repeatable 3-second avatar/follow ending using private profile data, or render it alone. | `capcutctl ending --project NAME --dry-run` |
| `logo` **T** | Brand mark pop with its cue, timed off the transcript or --at. | `capcutctl logo --project NAME --auto --plan` |
| `mograph` add\|list\|preview\|render\|rerender\|scene-preview\|scene-render\|scenes **T** | Rendered HTML/JS motion graphics: list, preview, render, add on a word, rerender. | `capcutctl mograph add --project NAME --template keyword-super --params '{"text":"أسرع"}' --say "أسرع" --dry-run` |
| `motion` **T** | EXPERIMENTAL native text/logo recipes; prefer mograph. | `capcutctl motion list` |
| `sfx` **T** | Place a palette sound or your own audio --file (whoosh, click, voice patch) at set times; overlaps take the next lane. | `capcutctl sfx --project NAME --sound typing --cues 8.03:2.8:2,31.1:1.2:10 --volume 0.5 --dry-run` |
| `wrap` **T** | Logos from what is said + the endcard in one pass. | `capcutctl wrap --project NAME --plan` |

## Seams, music and mix

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `denoise` **T** | Measure-first voice cleanup; video and timing untouched. | `capcutctl denoise --project NAME --plan` |
| `finish` **T** | Scorecard + ASCII (read-only), or --music / --polish writes. | `capcutctl finish --project NAME` |
| `loudness` **T** | Measure the edited mix; match speech/SFX to target LUFS with peak headroom. | `capcutctl loudness --project NAME --measure` |
| `music` **T** | Music bed from a file or brief, aligned to hits; --duck under speech. | `capcutctl music --project NAME --file bed.mp3 --hits 2.4,8.1 --plan --json` |
| `polish` **T** | Transitions + paired SFX on picture changes (--motivated). | `capcutctl polish --project NAME --motivated --dry-run` |

## Check and review

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `alpha` | Premultiply ProRes alpha overlays in place; CapCut paints a straight file's hidden colour as a haze. | `capcutctl alpha --project NAME` |
| `check-export` | QA the rendered file: black, flash frames, freezes, dead air, loudness, true peak, canvas and length. | `capcutctl check-export --media final.mp4 --project NAME` |
| `diff` | What changed since a snapshot or another project; --allow proves a scoped edit stayed in scope. | `capcutctl diff --project NAME --snapshot NAME --allow SEGMENT-ID,track:broll` |
| `doctor` | Structural integrity; must be error-free before hand-off. --fix repairs a CapCut resave first. | `capcutctl doctor --project NAME --fix --dry-run` |
| `gate` | Blocking ready-to-post check from the profile's motion grammar. | `capcutctl gate --project NAME` |
| `preview` | Lightweight proxy with audio. | `capcutctl preview --project NAME --out preview.mp4` |
| `qa` | Composite real frames (incl. keyframes, grades, mograph clips); --expect gates text. | `capcutctl qa --project NAME --times 3,9,15 --sheet` |
| `reference` | Measure a reference reel's pacing in the gate's terms; --profile-out writes the density override. | `capcutctl reference --media reel.mp4 --project NAME --sheet shots.png` |
| `review` | Proxy + EDL + contact sheet into outputs/. | `capcutctl review --project NAME` |
| `review-video` | Gemini watches the final export in your own Chrome; a verified second opinion, two rounds max. | `capcutctl review-video --media final.mp4 --project NAME` |
| `xray` audio\|bench\|frame\|jev-setup\|scan\|selftest\|window | Every frame and sample of a real export measured; exact-frame queries; honest verdicts. | `capcutctl xray scan export.mp4 --project NAME` |

## Snapshots and repair

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `apply` **T** | Apply a v1 spec of operations transactionally. | `capcutctl apply --project NAME --spec spec.json --dry-run` |
| `history` | List snapshots. | `capcutctl history --project NAME` |
| `init-spec` | A blank v1 spec to fill in. | `capcutctl init-spec --output spec.json` |
| `notes` | Creative log: rejected looks and why, accepted look, decisions, outstanding; survives restore. | `capcutctl notes --project NAME --reject "orange captions" --why "fights the indigo frame"` |
| `restore` **T** | Restore a snapshot. | `capcutctl restore --project NAME --snapshot NAME --dry-run` |
| `rm` **T** | Move a project to the recycle bin (recoverable). | `capcutctl rm --project NAME --dry-run` |
| `snapshot` | Snapshot the project. | `capcutctl snapshot --project NAME --label before-build` |
| `stage` commit\|discard\|start\|status **T** | Stage-and-swap: edit a copy outside CapCut's folder with CapCut open; commit is the one closed-CapCut step. | `capcutctl stage start --project NAME` |
| `sync` **T** | Repair mirror drift and duplicate material ids. | `capcutctl sync --project NAME --dry-run` |

## Export (explicit request only)

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `export` | Native CapCut export through the macOS bridge; explicit request only. | `capcutctl export --project NAME --out final.mp4 --grid grid.png` |
| `export-grid` | Labelled frame grid from an existing video. | `capcutctl export-grid --media final.mp4 --out grid.png --times 0,8,15` |

## Development

| Command | What it is for | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `harvest` | Catalogue transitions/SFX/masks/keyframes from real drafts. | `capcutctl harvest --plan` |
| `oracle` capture\|diff | Dev-only round-trip capture/diff of a disposable project. | `capcutctl oracle diff --before A --after B` |
